messages:
alex: kicking off change window for embeddings-service — rolling 20% traffic to embeddings-v2-quantized now. monitor p95, 5xx, and kvcache latency. deploy-bot: rollout started: embeddings-service -> embeddings-v2-quantized (20%). tracked rollout id r-2026-03-21-01 :rocket:
maria: on it. watching SLO dashboard (dashboard: /dash/slo/embeddings-service). will call if p95 > 120ms or error rate > 0.5% :eyes:
jordan: FYI I pushed a small LRU tweak to cache config in configmap earlier. should be fine but flagged in the change notes.
lee: seeing a small uptick in KV cache miss rate in eu-west-1, +3.2% 5m. not yet impacting p95 but noticing higher tail latencies on warmups.
alex: can you paste the quick query?
lee: ```query
sum(rate(kvcache_miss_total{service="embeddings-service"}[1m])) by (region)
```
lee: results: eu-west-1: 48/s, us-west-2: 12/s, us-east-1: 9/s
maria: p95 is drifting — was 95ms baseline, now 130ms for the 20% shard in eu-west-1. ops-alert threshold is 120ms. :rotating_light:
jordan: seeing 5xx rate up from 0.08% to 0.42% in the canary slice (60m window). stack traces show redis timeouts on a subset of pods. linking trace: https://traces.internal/abc123
sre-bot: SLO breach watch: embeddings-service canary slice p95 >120ms (alert id slo-784). auto-notification to eng-oncall in 3m unless acknowledged.
alex: acknowledge. will hold ramp until we triage. not rolling to 50%.
maria: quick diff of the configmap shows the LRU window decreased — might evict too aggressively after quantized model increases KV pressure. Jordan, can you roll configmap back to previous LRU and restart canary pods?
jordan: running:
```bash
kubectl apply -f configmap/kvcache-lru.yaml --record
kubectl rollout restart deployment/embeddings-service-canary
```
jordan: done. pods restarting.
lee: after restart p95 trending back down in canary slice to ~110ms. 5xx rate dropping to 0.12%.
alex: good sign. proposal: keep canary at 20% for another 30m and re-evaluate. if stable, proceed to 60% ramp. if spike returns, rollback and pin back to embeddings-v1.
maria: SGTM. I'll keep watch and annotate the rollout in the release notes. deploy-bot: rollout update: embeddings-service -> embeddings-v2-quantized at 20% (stable).
sre-bot: reminder: if we decide to pin, use `deployctl pin --service embeddings-service --version embeddings-v1 --reason "canary instability"` (will route all traffic to v1 within ~30s).
jordan: also recommend adding a KV cache warmup async job before next ramp to reduce misses. created ticket: https://issues.redwood/INF-987
lee: agree. adding a small circuit-breaker to redis client in the canary path might reduce cascading timeouts.
alex: thanks all. keeping this thread open. we'll update in 30m with final decision. :thumbsup:
